title: Three thousand elk in one winter #Shorts
description:
In one winter hunters killed some 3,000 elk in and around early Yellowstone, just for their hides, while tourists broke off geyser cones as souvenirs.

▶ Full documentary (Part 2, When the Cavalry Guarded the Geysers): https://youtu.be/P99Gu3GCZVw
